system.description: Whether the manse is an underground cave system, habitation dome or multi-tiered tower city, it can care for a group of individuals whose Magnitude equals (its level + 1). Filters purify air and water, and jade-lined gardens grow and prepare food automatically. Animals that need more nourishment might count as two to five people, depending on appetite, but a group of the correct size can survive in a Provider manse indefinitely.
